title: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN
CHIEF MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
ACT I OF 1996
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan. Extraordinary, 14th February, 1996]
No.PAB/LEGIS:(22)/95. dated
14-2-1996.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly on 21st January, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--This Act may be called the
Balochistan Chief Minister arid Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 7-B in Act III of 1975

ACT I OF 1996
BALOCHISTAN
CHIEF MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
ACT I OF 1996
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Balochistan. Extraordinary, 14th February, 1996]
No.PAB/LEGIS:(22)/95. dated
14-2-1996.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly on 21st January, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
2. Insertion of new section 7-B in Act III of 1975.--In the said
Act, after section 7-A, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"7-B.
Custom duties or sales tax not leviable on certain articles.--No custom duties
or sales tax shall be levied on one car Mercedes Bens 280 Sel or equivalent for
his personal use if imported or purchased out of bond by a Chief Minister on
appointment or during his tenure of office."
